expo.name: OpenDating
expo.description: Privacy-first decentralized dating app — Tinder-quality UX with end-to-end encrypted messaging, coarse location privacy, and self-sovereign identity on Nostr.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: OpenDating uses your general area to help you discover people nearby. Your exact location is never shared.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: OpenDating needs access to your photos to set up your dating profile.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: OpenDating can use your camera to take new profile photos.
